plan.title: Plan
plan.subtitle: Proposed work — sessions that became spikes. Forged and run from your host agent.

research.subtitle: Books — broad material gathered to assist you. Started and accreted from your host agent.

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Every artifact the agent has minted — scenes, models, characters, materials, images, diagrams. One shelf per way of looking; the same recipe store underneath.

materials.blurb: Procedural materials — texture-free vertex colour: a lambert base, a top-lit ramp, a brushed cloud, and weathering, all baked into per-corner fills. Each swatch is a real quad run through the real resolver, so what you see is what a face gets.
materials.applyHint: Materials are applied by asking the agent — set material on a mesh-world face, or pass a preset name.

library.recentNote: The most recent artifacts across the workshop. Pick a shelf to see all of one kind.

inspector.empty: Select a row for its details.

beats.title: Beats
beats.subtitle: Synthesized soundtracks, compositions, and sound effects — select one and press play. Author new ones from your agent via create_beats.

voice.title: Voice
voice.subtitle: Voice registers — deterministic recipes for how a voice sounds: two axes over a calibrated bank of voices. Author new ones from your agent via create_voice; an external worker speaks them.
voice.empty: No voice registers yet. Ask your agent to mint one with create_voice.
voice.unresolvable: This register no longer resolves — its bank may have changed. Re-mint it via create_voice.

motion.title: Motion
motion.subtitle: Animated artifacts from forge_motion, grouped by Motion Project. Each tile opens a frame-accurate player.
motion.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, motion, ref, or project…
motion.emptyHint: Create one from your host agent with forge_motion — put a manji-tree subject in motion (turntable, orbit, push_in, dolly_zoom, flythrough).

cooks.title: Output Artifacts
cooks.subtitle: Materialized publications from cook(). Each row links to its outcome page.
cooks.emptyHint: Ask your agent to run the cook MCP tool against a stash.

stashes.title: Stashes
stashes.subtitle: Buckets of typed material the agent has gathered.
stashes.emptyHint: Ask your agent to mint one with the mint_stash MCP tool, or to enter research mode and gather material.

detail.notFoundBody: This stash ref does not exist or has not been minted yet.
detail.noItemsInDrawer: No items in this drawer yet.
detail.deferredRenderer: Full renderer ships in a later step. Use get_stash via your agent to read content for now.
detail.stubPointerHint: Resolves to contextmap node {nodeRef} via your agent.

sketchesIndex.title: Sketches
sketchesIndex.subtitle: Diagrams the operator agent has minted via create_sketch. Click one to preview, expand for fullscreen.
sketchesIndex.emptyState: No sketches yet. Ask the agent to mint one with the create_sketch MCP tool.
sketchesIndex.selectPrompt: Select a sketch on the left to preview.
sketchesIndex.invalidManifest: Rendrant could not parse this sketch.

beatsNoun.emptyState: No tracks yet. Ask the agent to mint one with the create_beats MCP tool.
beatsNoun.selectPrompt: Select a track on the left to play.
beatsNoun.invalidManifest: This recipe could not be parsed.

observability.title: Observability
observability.subtitle: MCP tool-layer telemetry: one row per handler call across both transports. Records shapes and timings only — never input values or conversation content.
observability.empty: No tool calls recorded yet. Telemetry records once the host agent starts calling MCP tools.

renderBay.title: Render Bay
renderBay.subtitle: Everything mojulo is producing, in one place: the durable image-render queue, GI bakes, and the cooks and exports on disk. Four ways of saying "something is being made" that used to have no shared home.

queue.title: Render queue
queue.note: Durable render requests parked for an image-capable worker. A request survives a restart, so a parked row is a promise, not an in-memory job.
queue.empty: Nothing parked. Ask the agent to request_image_render for a minted image-outcome or sequential-art sketch.
queue.eyesGate: ← the eyes gate: the machine is done, nobody has looked

bakes.title: GI bakes
bakes.note: Blender Cycles global illumination baked into a world's own vertex colours — soft AO and contact shadow at zero runtime cost. Needs a local Blender; the baked worlds ship to anyone.
bakes.empty: No bakes yet. With Blender installed: node scripts/bake-world-gi.mjs --ref <world> --preset interior-day --write
bakes.machineGate: machine gate passed · {match} corner match · {black} dark floor (limit {limit})
bakes.eyesGate: eyes gate: yours — open it and look

outputs.title: Cooks and exports
outputs.note: What has been materialized onto disk: publications from cook, and the models, meshes, renders, skins, voices and scores bound into each artifact's outcome folder.
outputs.emptyArtifacts: No exports on disk yet. Ask the agent to export_model a world, or bind a render.
outputs.emptyBeats: No beats renders on disk yet.

outliner.title: Outliner
outliner.flat: A flat recipe — no parts to walk.
outliner.unnamed: Structure mojulo has no word for yet. It is still in the recipe.
outliner.isolate: Isolate in the viewport — click again to clear
